scope.required_state: player availability/injury information knowable before target tip

candidate_source.semantic_note: The feed returns injuries updated on a given date; it is not documented as a complete immutable snapshot of every active injury at every intra-day timestamp.

supports: WNBA API data availability goes back to the 2015 season.
Daily Injuries is listed among feeds that can be used for historical WNBA retrieval.
The guide warns that newly added data points are typically available in the most recent API version from the point they are added going forward.
The endpoint accepts year/month/day path parameters.
The feed provides details for injuries updated on a given date.
Injury availability updates depend on scheduled game time.
Daily Injuries endpoint release date is 2024-08-30.
The endpoint was introduced to track injury updates by day over time.
Teams must submit player participation/injury information before games under league reporting deadlines.
Reports are updated continually throughout the day.

scientific_interpretation.reason: Sportradar documents Daily Injuries as historically queryable, but the endpoint was only introduced on 2024-08-30 and Sportradar separately cautions that newly added data points are generally available from introduction forward. Documentation alone therefore does not prove complete injury-update coverage for 2021-2023 or the pre-release portion of 2024.
scientific_interpretation.reason_intra_day: A daily list of updates is not by itself proof of the exact state visible at a specific pre-tip cutoff. Reconstruction requires update_date/content sequencing and a deterministic rule that never incorporates an update first known after target tip.

minimum_checks: Query representative in-season dates from each season 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025.
Verify whether 2021-2023 and pre-2024-08-30 requests return genuine historical injury records rather than empty/unavailable responses caused by endpoint inception.
Measure game-day injury coverage over the intended cohort, not just endpoint HTTP availability.
Verify injury identifiers, start_date, update_date, status and comments are sufficient to order state changes without target-game participation inference.
Demonstrate a deterministic as-of-target-tip state constructor that ignores updates learned after tip.
Freeze raw-response hashes and a coverage report before any target outcomes are opened.

allowed: Preregister a distinct injury-neutral candidate before outcomes are opened.
Use a narrower certified injury era only as secondary validation while preserving the original 2021-2025 objective as unresolved.
Acquire another timestamped historical availability source and subject it to the same audit.
forbidden: Treat missing injury state as healthy or zero adjustment.
Infer injury state from target-game minutes, box score, recap or final participation.
Use a later injury report as though it were known before target tip.
Open target outcomes and then choose the source/coverage rule.

closure.primary_finding: Sportradar is the strongest identified historical injury-source candidate, but documentation does not yet prove complete 2021-2025 pre-tip coverage.
